notes.title: RELEASE OF THE GAME RUSSIAN VILLAGE SIMULATOR ON MARS!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!
Here comes that momentous day - the release of the game Russian Village Simulator on Mars, which we have been working on for more than a year!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800460
[previewyoutube=k6CAPMR35UQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We tried to fulfill almost all wishes of players from Russian Village Simulator.

We added the following to the release version:
1. New quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/03c109e98dc1268ba7f52607c047f74e2028578d.jpg[/img]
2. New characters.
3. References to Russian folklore.
4. 33 new achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/3263c92ee38811abba9b4ba83cc6d5b1b26de0e8.jpg[/img]
5. Ability to pick up all types of fences.
6. Have broken down all quests by level so there is no confusion when completing them.
7. Corrected the translations into Russian.
8. Reduced the number of transportation in the quests.
9. Corrected the balance of prices.
10. Added more resources for crafting beds.
11. Added new cat scenes per level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/6290f2cbe72056ea98fbf1b7a1924299e19cc10e.jpg[/img]
12. New animals to the village - cats and dogs and photographing them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/534695737c04f321e3426abee8223b75dbb291f7.jpg[/img]
13. And other small changes.

[h3]We hope that you will like the game, because we put all our soul into it, read your comments and watched all the videos to make our game better!
We will further develop our project, as well as the first part of the game. It has quite a lot of potential![/h3]
[h2]We are waiting for your activity and your feedback, because the further development of the project depends on it![/h2]

notes.title: PATCH #3
notes.content:
Hello players!
It's been a week, which means it's time to release another patch.

We have made the following fixes and improvements:
1. Made it possible to steam in the bathhouse. You will be able to buy wood for the bathhouse from Kuplenovsky after completing all of his quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/b252f1718490a37d8a77768d4432e9e399e3d2b4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/01c893204c79e630f54c10cf2120307ca3d53e25.jpg[/img]

2. Anyone who has failed sellers - they will go back to their place.
3. If you have no animals there will be no more notification after the barns are installed.
4. Added the ability to sleep on the bed.
5. The gazebo can now only be set up on the lawn, and can also be taken into inventory.

8. Added the ability to take the table saw and workbench back into inventory. But their contents will be irrevocably deleted.
9. Removed the ability to craft doors for the greenhouse since the greenhouse already has them.
10. Equalized in price logs and boards.
11. Now when taking quests related to transportation, transportation is added to the base of quick call, which can be called on Q.
12. HUD stops can now be closed on Escape.
13. A police robot has been added.

notes.title: GLOBAL PATCH
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends!
During two weeks we made several patches, but we didn't write about it because we were very busy answering your questions and feedback. We have also been watching various videos on our game in order to improve the game quickly. We have been to all the streamers on our game and asked everyone what needs to be improved.

[b][i]We will not describe everything, but we will write only the main things:[/i][/b]
1. Fixed the quests from Julia and Drozdov.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/aa574bc7bd58efc2bc239f5d768d0075b0eefe6c.jpg[/img]
2. Made it check to pick up items in inventory and when taking a quest if your inventory is full.
3. Added honeydew. It can be made on the stove.
4. Now from all animals, except for small animals, fall the correct resources.
5. All baby animals do not require the ability to feed and drink them.
6. The campfire has been removed.
7. You can take the stove, oven, moonshine machine, shredder for grinding grain into flour into your inventory and correctly install them elsewhere.
8. You can now install furniture without any problems.
9. Baba Nyura becomes a salesman and buys your mailing lists.
10. Visually increased the display of required ingredients when crafting.
11. Animals can be taken back into the inventory if it is not full.
12. Fixed the texts in Russian.
13. Added a log replenishment point for log delivery.
14. A pig can be slaughtered when it reaches the progress bar of its resource - meat.
15. Improved the location of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/c3c92b0139aef10e58e6912fb912f2a1a205af8e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/9eb9eba0f7cbb937b9bc943e130f55cda5b84090.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/50fc52c45a8b5442552bc92a740615a37a242b4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/1c3266996b5e16d204b76aaa55d306be3a7d969e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/3e6cb19e8fcfb92600f572eaf69183afdddedc0a.jpg[/img]

16. Added bow and arrow crafting. They can be crafted anywhere in the character menu.
17. Reduced the price to buy a lawn.
18. Merchants now do not fall under the textures when loading. Those who have them fell - use an older autosafe.
19. Added scrap metal Ilya at the metal depot - a quest item for Grandpa Maxim.
20. Fixed fishing.
21. Reworked the lighting (dark textures).
22. Added a flashlight to the character. Called on the F button.
23. Improved the transportation system.
24. And much more.

[h3]We follow your progress and if possible answer all questions on our forum in Steam.[/h3]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS GAME RELEASE!
notes.content:
[b]Here comes the long awaited day of releasing our game into early access![/b].

[previewyoutube=k6CAPMR35UQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been working on this project for a whole year: we fixed various bugs, lags from the first part of the game and added almost everything that players asked for in the first part of the game.
The project is big and not everything has been realized and finalized yet. But even now it has already [b]more than 100 quests[/b], a system of construction, animal reproduction, voice acting, improved mini-map and large map, improved game mechanics and so on. List can be very long everything that has already been realized in the game.

Please note that the project is in early access and will be improved as possible. We want you to leave feedback and write feedback on the game in our community.
[h3]Thanks to you our project will become better![/h3]

tags.feature: - more than 100 quests
- a system of construction
- animal reproduction
- voice acting
- improved mini-map and large map
- improved game mechanics

notes.title: Developer Diaries #4
notes.content:
Developer Diaries #4

Hello everyone Today is the big report! 
We've done a herculean job the work for these two weeks. We work from morning till evening! Fixed and added what the players requested in the last game. 

1. We made the "I'm stuck" button - it will teleport you to the hospital (you won't get stuck in our game anymore).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/32bc12493b1912f16f04d381158a5f61dffb5762.png[/img]
2. Added the ability to take items back to inventory if you don't like their position on the map. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/c4b10075fb85d03ba525133b996307aa76dbc3e6.png[/img]
3. Added more references to the village. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/c96dc4da517df62de31a6838c42d2dc8d44dba3c.png[/img]
4. There will be small activities in the village in the morning and evening (for example, someone will be gardening in the morning and guarding it at night). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/15c69cc02ee635c1d30d56e70ea32a6747fd098d.png[/img]
5. Locals will be able to exchange short monologues about life in the village.
6. It will be possible to interact with NPCs and exchange goods for things you are interested in. 
7. Now almost every quest affects life in the village (for example, you complete a quest and will be able to trade and buy the necessary goods or move through the story). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/548d29214e8f3a4aa9ead88af7673471ffdc319d.png[/img]
8. All quests will be divided into levels so that players don't take everything in a row and don't know what to do. You can complete quests and gain experience for it.
9. The player will be able to upgrade: strength, agility, endurance. 
10. In the game you can hunt: bears, foxes, hares, wild boars, wolves. Their habitat areas will be shown on the map, and if you are nearby, they will be displayed on the mini-map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/d0d703f68e1c9fb3bf45338ad1714b16a864d495.png[/img] 
11. We have added new transport and work to it - taxi and Ambulance!
12.Added swimming sounds.
13.Added the ability to adjust the sensitivity of the mouse along the axes.
14. Added breeding: cows, sheep, pigs. The pig will grow gradually.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/cdcbb1c52b40f123db682ad90cbee3638abd06ea.png[/img]
15. Added the ability to buy household appliances (refrigerator, stove, samovar) at a metal depot. 
16. We added a samovar and 6 types of tea to create. 
17. Added the ability to plant: pears, peaches, plums, apple trees of two types, raspberries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/af19b15f1f8ee6d3fe2114dab2ed8e22341e8d26.png[/img]
18. Added the ability to collect new herbs.
19. Added the ability to set up three types of hives!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/a8e87678f0a661933ae963bf9374e470d44331e4.png[/img]
20. Added grain processing and flour creation.
21. Added new types of mushrooms!
22. Added the ability to create 4 types of kvass!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/222d400f55ae88496fd55a6f13560c0a47d2a99a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/7fb675e59a0ffee1d8fa6599cb4d4beb3cfd7b26.png[/img]

notes.title: DEVELOPER DIARIES #3
notes.content:
[b]Hello, our dear players! [/b]
Day and night we are working on the game! We pay attention to all wishes for the game and realize them for you! 
1. Added a bicycle, it can perform various tricks and tasks, it has a high passability, but watch the road, or you will fly over the handlebars. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/a6960e93210f8ec87fabaa419c0cf63b3b5251ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/317f2d086968e5c081b10620ec9e9f48202df1ef.png[/img]
2. Added camera and animal photo quests and an album where you can view them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/8a95b6187635990d869e49fee63ad22b7b79d89a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/07a8182843f2203b8c484ffab6561c7ee589d27b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/8bd644102871f14d72034e3c5671bdd31a72c0de.png[/img]
3. Added a combat system, as well as the ability to get caught up with your grandmother if you steal her crops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/01cda91ee90806366874aa31d6c68dc800dc7857.png[/img]
4. Added a police system, in case of offense you will go to jail! 
5. Added the ability to unlock stops, they won't be available right away, you have to find them and have a ride pass to use them. 
6. Added the ability to summon transportation if it is stuck or broken, but for a small fee, also transportation will be given gradually during quests. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/3f701c64b892aa37138f1b1dd1e6025f72e0d4c8.png[/img]
7. Added cow, goat and sheep reproduction. All of these are available when building barns. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/18851677184f98c22de5aa556a79268965e92cf2.png[/img]
8. Finalized some locations. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/c21ee902c6e5c981add484d73abceb4530d73fd3.png[/img]
9. Added small scenes for quests and story missions. 
10. Added frame generation, for RTX 40-50 series graphics cards, and updated DLSS, which will double the frame count on these graphics cards. 
11. Added a flying tractor as a reference. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/364b31eaa62c20a6aaa396cf4796bf2bde4584be.png[/img]
12. Added night quests. 
13. Added a goat and goats.
14.Added a new voiceover. 
15. Added new references to Russian folklore. 
16. The game will be hints at interesting facts about the life of animals in nature. 
17. Added birdhouses. 
18. Significantly improved the map and mini map! You can put a GPS point and track the direction in meters! 
-Map scaling and the ability to move it! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/ca99e1b91c5309c27ec8de53cc849ed0a81a462b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/bf72c1ffa7867a25111dea3d98bd2c6a14d68685.png[/img]

[h2]P/S We are pleased to inform you that the project will be released on the deadline of March 25! [/h2]
[b]We will be updating the game, just like we did with SRD1, which got a lot of updates! Of course, everything depends only on you! 
We look forward to your support and wish you success! Thanks for everything![/b]

notes.title: GAME NEWS FROM 23 JANUARY 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone, dear villagers!
The New Year vacations are over, which means it's time to continue developing our favorite game.
1.We have significantly improved game locations, also finalized quest zones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/ac861f5e8282424a0b6586b68179b4dfaa4e49d9.png[/img]
-For example, in a quest where you had to collect bags, you can now see them better where they lie. 
2. Added new buildings for animals: chicken coop, egg incubator, cow house, pig house, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/8f056d17b96ca0c75b031df89d3a862c18fd6184.png[/img]
2.1 You can breed animals.
2.2 You can add a cow back to your inventory if it ran away.
2.3 Working on a cow milking system.
3. Added two types of fences, so that you can fence off unwanted guests.
4. Added chests and improved the mining of stones and iron ore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/95d385a234b185c43f88913432a04594a987f25b.png[/img]
5. Added a newspaper statement at death.
6. Added new 25 tracks written by our musician.
7. Improved the transportation system, now you have to watch your car, fix, fill gasoline and oil.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/4d776b489a3d18a06f4d352abef303f4716ad844.png[/img]
8. There will be a loaf flying around the map as a reference.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/c0a841b685826ab3bd0231dcef9fd7e287ce17c9.png[/img]
9. Added ant hills, cats, birds.
10. Working on the village museum, which will be added as a quest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/f7d5ce439a75a9c620b04f94460f3bcd75eab98f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/c631046b3aa56cef73796d9b1a3f6fffb9680af5.png[/img]
11. Improved the optimization of the game world.
12. Working on making the gamepad work in the game.
13. Added the ability to build feeders for animals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/d3fb09f68a4fe2b1a0fff419944f6fe5468781fa.png[/img]
14. Added the ability to change the color of the house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/7f55dcd23519917783889d874e438ad13ac49a75.png[/img]
15. Reduced the weight of some objects. (Added weights that were not in srd1)
16. Added chests to store items.
17. Added a refrigerator because food now has a shelf life.
18. Added and changed the saturation from food.
19. Added the ability to do landscaping, build lawns, gazebos, etc. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/38906b03f45177b0082315605e6b458942d87c75.png[/img]
[h3]All of this can be seen in early access soon! Stay tuned![/h3].
